interpretation.state_model: bounded pure-state statevector; at most 4 qubits
interpretation.parameter_grammar: restricted numeric/pi literals implemented by qasm_matrix._parse_angle; U requires exactly three comma-separated supported angles
interpretation.global_phase_policy: not_applicable_to_instrument_semantics; unitary gate actions retain exact complex phase
interpretation.measurement: c[i] = measure q[j] computational-basis projective measurement with explicit collapse; nondeterministic outcomes fail closed
interpretation.classical_state: explicit scalar or indexed measurement-bit names populated before use
interpretation.feedforward: if (<measured-bit> == 1) <supported gate>; indexed bits such as c[1] are supported; no else or loops
interpretation.branch_completeness: single deterministic execution only; nondeterministic branch enumeration is outside this profile

parser_or_interpreter.trust_role: externally_trusted bounded operational interpreter; not kernel-checked

notes: Executable bounded operational profile for deterministic-branch dynamic fragments. It is not full OpenQASM dynamic-circuit semantics, density-operator/channel semantics, hardware semantics, or an arbitrary-input teleportation proof. Includes are skipped syntactically and are not semantically imported.
